title: Investigating water in a delivery van
passage:
Thanks for coming down before lunch. The soup carrier is leaving water on the van floor again. Before we blame the seal, remember that the carrier sits on a low rack under the chilled-drink crates. Yesterday there was water on the outside of the lid before anyone touched the soup. We put a dry paper strip around the join where the lid meets the base and took the carrier around the block by itself. The strip came back dry.

I've asked dispatch to leave the soup on that low rack. It's the only shelf the cart can line up with, so nobody has to lift a full carrier by hand. The upper rack, where the drinks normally go, has a drain tray, but it was out for cleaning yesterday. It's back in place now.

One more thing: please put the paper strip on before loading today, but don't remove it at the delivery stop until you've checked which edge is wet. If the top is wet and the underside is dry, write that down rather than just ticking “wet.”
passageZh:
謝謝大家在午餐前過來一趟。運湯的保溫箱又讓貨車地板上出現積水了。先別怪密封處。別忘了，保溫箱放在低層架上，上面就是冰飲箱。昨天還沒有人動那箱湯，箱蓋外側就已經有水了。我們把一條乾紙條貼在箱蓋和箱身的接縫周圍，只載著保溫箱開車繞街區一圈。回來時，紙條還是乾的。

我已請調度人員把湯留在低層架上。那是唯一能跟推車對齊的層架，這樣沒有人需要徒手搬起裝滿湯的保溫箱。飲料平常放在上層架，那裡有個接水盤，不過昨天拿去清洗了。現在已經裝回去了。

還有一件事：今天裝貨前請先貼上紙條，但到了送貨地點，先看是哪一邊濕了，再取下來。如果上緣濕了、下緣是乾的，請把這個情況記下來，不要只勾選「濕」。
